title: Map later BIT physical caller contracts and the remaining consumer handoff
body:
## Summary

```text
bottleneck brief / dated logical caller map
  + physical-contract successor
      logical wrapper -> pending fixed-role caller -> B1 -> reached fast primitives
      remaining complex compact-operation interface and universal dependency audit
```

Repair a stale research handoff without rewriting its historical snapshot. Pin PR2808/2809/2899/2915 and distinguish incorporated downstream compositions from PR2809's still-partial universal-caller review. Record the real consumer boundary rather than assigning another ordinary-stage speedup.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, David Arias, Nick Petalas and the parking, substitution, factor-word, stock-fit and selected-source authors retained in the linked packages. No selected-frontier or scientific-source changes.

## Evidence

- Before: the dated caller/storage map leaves physical reuse, stronger primitives and the outer wrapper as implementation handoffs without their later source contracts. After: both entry pages reach the pinned successor and its explicit remaining obligations.
- Linux/WSL2, CPython 3.12.15: all eight registered `physical-ordinary-interchange` commands pass, matching complete typed receipts.
- `selected-bit-fast-primitives`: five registered suites pass before `complete` reaches its unchanged 600-second timeout. Separate cold `outer` and optimized `controls` pass. This is seven passing suites, **not a complete Linux replay**; the retained maintainer pass is separate evidence.
- Three package metadata/pin checks, four exact README/head/status bindings, 33 local links, six existing navigation tests, selected baseline and whitespace checks pass. Historical caller/storage content from its dated marker and selected-record bytes are unchanged.

Commands and exact source heads are in `docs/research/selected-bit-physical-contract-map.md`. This is navigation and scoped finite replay, not independent proof of universal caller arguments, selected GL64 execution, hosted CI or supplier admission.

Started from canonical main `9ee73fecdbae9f892a6496dbdfae872217cf4601`, revision 5. At 13:33 UTC, fetched main `95ff4e2dd396c505932a43ff7c1cdfdd94b8c867` had unchanged relevant guidance, source packages and scoped dispositions. Fresh overlap covered 473 open PRs, 2,162 closed PRs and 1,636 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Existing coordination: [caller handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18968527) and [encoded compact-operation claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-18971213). No retrospective advance reservation is claimed.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way

Documentation-only successor and entry links. Frozen predecessors, proof inputs and selected result are unchanged.

**Blast radius:** research-navigation
